I have this small piece near my house, only six sost metres of land, where I keep my enset and some vegetables mixed together. I will not buy chemical fertilizer or spray for this plot — one bag from the cooperative costs too much and is meant for my bigger maize and teff fields, so I will put cow dung and compost from my homestead on it instead. I will plant my own saved seeds and work this plot myself with my children for about twenty days over the season, weeding and harvesting by hand. The meher rain is enough here, so I do not irrigate it, and I never hire outside labor for such a small garden.
